
COMPACT-WORK-UNIT
Permanently remove soft-deleted items and renumber IDs sequentially (destructive operation)

USAGE
  fspec compact-work-unit <workUnitId>

ARGUMENTS
  <workUnitId> (required)
    Work unit ID

OPTIONS
  --force
    Skip confirmation prompt and compact during non-done status (use with caution)

EXAMPLES
  1. Compact work unit with confirmation prompt (safe, requires user input)
  $ fspec compact-work-unit AUTH-001
  ⚠ Warning: This will permanently remove 3 deleted items
Continue? (y/N) y
✓ Compacted AUTH-001
Removed 3 deleted items, renumbered remaining 7 items to IDs [0-6]

  2. Force compact without confirmation (use during non-done status)
  $ fspec compact-work-unit AUTH-001 --force
  ⚠ Warning: Compacting during "specifying" status permanently removes deleted items
✓ Compacted AUTH-001
Removed 3 deleted items

RELATED COMMANDS
  fspec show-deleted
  fspec restore-rule
  fspec update-work-unit-status

NOTES
  • Compaction is PERMANENT and cannot be undone
  • Removes all soft-deleted items (deleted: true)
  • Renumbers remaining items sequentially starting from 0
  • Resets nextId counters to match remaining item count
  • Preserves chronological order (sorted by createdAt timestamp)
  • Auto-compact triggers when moving work unit to "done" status
  • Requires --force flag when compacting during non-done status
